message.name: LEAF_SET_RC_LOSS_BEHAVIOR
message.description: Select the racer behaviour on RC-link loss: whether LeafFC generates a takeover CRSF frame or stays silent so Betaflight runs its own failsafe.
message.field: 1 = LeafFC generates a takeover RC frame (keep flying under guidance); 0 = LeafFC stays silent so Betaflight runs its own failsafe

message.name: LEAF_PI_HEALTH
message.description: Companion-computer (Raspberry Pi) SoC health telemetry (drone to GS). Sampled only while DISARMED; while armed the last disarmed sample is repeated with stale=1.
message.field: Minimum core voltage over the sample burst, mV
Mean core voltage over the sample burst, mV
vcgencmd present and at least one probe succeeded (0/1)
Sample is not live: armed, or the sampler is wedged (0/1)
Number of core-voltage samples in the burst
Seconds since the last good sample, saturating at 255

message.name: LEAF_TARGET_GPS_VISION_CORRELATION_CONFIRM
message.description: Operator confirmation that the target GPS track and the vision track refer to the same target. Forwarded to the vision tracker so it may fuse the target GPS with its vision estimate.
message.field: 1 = the operator confirms the target GPS and the vision track are the same target; 0 = not confirmed
